status: specified before native-dynamics extraction, fitting, new corpus and outcomes
scope: two predeclared external endpoints, finite-budget local study; no claim of public preregistration or native metacognition
training: original 1000 training solution groups only, saved correction visible features and labels; original calibration/test not used for model selection

representation.time: after incorporating level9 codes, before level10 generation
representation.static: z9 at the 81 expected token positions, 256 channels; decoder input coordinates, not assumed cell-local semantics
representation.PCA: 16 per representation, separately fit on all blank cells of training groups, never on held-out groups
representation.baseline: 388 previously defined observable cell features; exact observable history bounded at level9

comparisons.static: visible plus 16 static PCs plus 3 amplitude controls
comparisons.shuffle: static plus 16 within-puzzle shuffled delta PCs, before error cohort selection

learning.folds: original 5 training folds by solution group
learning.selection: mean within-puzzle AUROC; ties 1e-8 choose larger lambda
learning.objective: equal puzzle-weighted logistic log-loss plus lambda L2/2; no class weighting
learning.scaling: observables and amplitude floor std 0.1; PCA channels and scores unit scaled

external.selection: randomized backtracking and greedy removal with independently verified unique solution, no NCM outcome selection
external.exclude: official 2000 solutions, previous external 1000, generator pilot32, and new corpus duplicates under digit relabeling and dihedral transforms; not full Sudoku isomorphisms

prediction_primary.target: final persistence among wrong initially blank cells at level9, oracle-defined cohort
prediction_primary.metric: equal-weight mean within-puzzle AUROC over puzzles with both persistent and corrected errors
prediction_primary.interval: 10000 paired mixed-puzzle bootstrap; 97.5 percent two-sided interval for two primary endpoints, seed20261202
prediction_primary.secondary: visible/static comparisons, noise/shuffle, pooled AUROC, Brier, leave-one-training-fold refits sensitivity if primary useful

causal.selection: first1500 new corpus groups, fixed before any model scoring
causal.position: one code position uniform seeded per puzzle, seed20261203
treatments: another code excluding original and runner-up, closest induced latent perturbation norm to runner-up; ties smaller ID
causal.norm_matching: best available discrete match, residual mismatch reported; not exact matching
causal.intervention: force only selected argmax at level8 using temporary head output hook, all other generation unchanged
causal.fixed_tail: same forced code but original clean levels9..12 codes, decoded without regenerating future codes
causal.primary: runner-up adaptive final strictly verified resolution indicator minus fixed-tail final strictly verified resolution indicator
secondary: cosine future residual response with negative initial perturbation
final latent perturbation norm / initial norm
recovery and damage relative to clean
causal.warning: fixed-tail contrast tests response of later generation, not optimality or metacognitive monitoring; no correction labels enter intervention choice

power: normal paired sensitivity scenarios saved before external outcomes; historical mixed prevalence0.145 is a planning assumption. Finite n chosen for local budget; inconclusive if interval too wide, no guaranteed 80 percent power
gates: 32 old training technical puzzles; exact latent reconstruction/final prediction parity; sham bitwise equality; prefix codes unaffected by intervention; hooks and caches cleared; unchanged weights
all methods and coefficients hashed before external inference
verify saved scores with independent direct pairwise AUROC; compare bootstrap and paired counts; no test tuning
interpretation: positive prediction result establishes accessible dynamic information; positive causal result establishes compensation under tested interventions. Neither alone proves a second-order reliability representation or native metacognition. Delta is a deterministic transform of two states.
